notes: Generic 'how well do you know your partner' set. Written from the partner's point of view ('I', 'me'); the host reads them to the guest of honour who guesses the partner's answer. Tone: playful, safe for a mixed table. `context` is for translators: what kind of answer is expected.

questions.text: What is my go-to karaoke song?
questions.context: A song title, possibly with the artist.

questions.text: Beach or mountains?
questions.context: One of the two, maybe with a reason.

questions.text: What was the first film we watched together?
questions.context: A film title; 'I don't remember' is a fun answer too.

questions.text: What would I order at a restaurant if money were no object?
questions.context: A dish or a whole menu.

questions.text: What is my biggest pet peeve?
questions.context: A small thing that annoys the partner.

questions.text: Who was my celebrity crush as a teenager?
What is the one thing I always forget to pack?
Cats or dogs?
What is my guilty-pleasure TV show?
questions.context: A show the partner is slightly embarrassed to love.

questions.text: What is my favourite thing about you?
questions.context: A trait or habit of the guest of honour.

questions.text: What would I do with a free Sunday and no plans?
What is my most-used emoji?
What was my first job?
Coffee or tea, and how do I take it?
Which household chore do I secretly hate the most?
What is my dream holiday destination?
Name a song that always gets me on the dance floor.
What am I most likely to be late for?
questions.context: An event or type of appointment.

questions.text: What did I want to be when I was eight?
What is my favourite way to celebrate good news?
